strings.name: Bill McKibben
strings.summary: McKibben brought climate change into public discussion through books including The End of Nature. He co-founded 350.org, organized international action, opposed fossil-fuel projects and promoted divestment. With partners he created Third Act for older organizers, combining writing, community work and nonviolent action. In 2025 he published a solar-energy book and helped organize Sun Day, emphasizing clean energy and civic participation.

strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded 350.org and organizes transnational climate action; his writing and fossil-fuel divestment advocacy influence the global environmental movement.
